verses.en: Thus saith the LORD; For three transgressions of Moab, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because he burned the bones of the king of Edom into lime:
verses.sm: Moapi, ma Iuta, ma Isaraelu O loo faapea mai le ALII, E tolu agasala a Moapi, e fa foi, ou te le liliu ese ai lana sala; auā na ia susunuina ivi o le tupu o Etoma na liu panisina.

verses.en: But I will send a fire upon Moab, and it shall devour the palaces of Kerioth: and Moab shall die with tumult, with shouting, and with the sound of the trumpet:
verses.sm: A e ou te tuuina atu le afi i Moapi, e faaumatia ai maota o Kiriota; e oti Moapi i le yaya6, ma le alaga, ma le leo o le pu.

verses.en: And I will cut off the judge from the midst thereof, and will slay all the princes thereof with him, saith the LORD.
verses.sm: Ou te faaumatia le faamasino o i lea mea, ou te fasiotia faatasi ma ia o alii uma, o loo fetalai mai ai le ALII.

verses.en: Thus saith the LORD; For three transgressions of Judah, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they have despised the law of the LORD, and have not kept his commandments, and their lies caused them to err, after the which their fathers have walked:
verses.sm: O loo faapea mai le ALI, E tolu agasala a Iuta, e fa foi, ou te le liliu ese ai lana sala; auā na latou lafoai le tulafono a le ALII, e lei tausi foi e i latou ana poloaiga; ua faaseseina i latou i a latou mea pepelo, sa naunau atu i ai o latou tama.

verses.en: But I will send a fire upon Judah, and it shall devour the palaces of Jerusalem.
verses.sm: A e ou te tuuina atu le afi i Iuta, e faaumatia ai maota o Ierusalema.

verses.en: Thus saith the LORD; For three transgressions of Israel, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they sold the righteous for silver, and the poor for a pair of shoes;
verses.sm: O loo faapea mai le ALII, E tolu agasala a Isaraelu, e fa foi, ou te le liliu ese ai lana sala; auā na latou faatauina atu le ua amiotonu i ario, male ua mativa i seevae e lua.

verses.en: That pant after the dust of the earth on the head of the poor, and turn aside the way of the meek: and a man and his father will go in unto the same maid, to profane my holy name:
verses.sm: O e naunau atu i le efuefu o le laueleele i ulu o e matitiva, ma latou lilju ese le ala o e agamalu; e alu ane foi le tagata atoa ma lona tamā i le teine e toatasi, ina ia ta‘uvaleina ai loʻu igoa paia.

verses.en: And they lay themselves down upon clothes laid to pledge by every altar, and they drink the wine of the condemned in the house of their god.
verses.sm: Ua latou taooto foi i ofu ua tuu faafaatau i tafatafa o fata faitaulaga uma; ma ua latou inu uaina a e ua faasalaina i le fale o latou atua.

verses.en: Yet destroyed I the Amorite before them, whose height was like the height of the cedars, and he was strong as the oaks; yet I destroyed his fruit from above, and his roots from beneath.
verses.sm: A o aʻu, na ou faaumatia le sa Amori ai o latou luma, o lona maualuga e pei o le maualuga o arasi ia, sa malosi foi o ia e pei o aluna; na ou faaumatia foi lona fua i luga ma ona aa i lalo.

verses.en: Also I brought you up from the land of Egypt, and led you forty years through the wilderness, to possess the land of the Amorite.
verses.sm: Io Na ou aveina ae foi outou ai le nuu o Aikupito; na ou taʻitaʻiina outou i tausaga E fagafulu i le vao e maua ai le laueleele o le sa Amori.

verses.en: And I raised up of your sons for prophets, and of your young men for Nazarites. Is it not even thus, O ye children of Israel? saith the LORD.
verses.sm: Na ou faatuina ni o outou atalii e fai ma perofeta, ma ni o outou taulelea e fai ma naseri. Le fanauga a Isaraelu e, e le ua faapea lava ea? o loo fetalai mai ai le ALII.

verses.en: But ye gave the Nazarites wine to drink; and commanded the prophets, saying, Prophesy not.
verses.sm: A ua outou avatua uaina i le au naseri e inu ai, ma vavao atu ile au perofeta, o loo faapea atu, Aua le vavalo mai.

verses.en: Behold, I am pressed under you, as a cart is pressed that is full of sheaves.
verses.sm: Faauta, ou te taomia outou i lalo, e pei ona taomia o le eleele i le fata faataavalevale ua tumu i fusi saito.

verses.en: Therefore the flight shall perish from the swift, and the strong shall not strengthen his force, neither shall the mighty deliver himself:
verses.sm: E iu vale le solaaga o le tele vave, e le faateleina e le ua malosi lona malosi; o le toa foi na te le faasaoina lona lava ola.

verses.en: Neither shall he stand that handleth the bow; and he that is swift of foot shall not deliver himself: neither shall he that rideth the horse deliver himself.
verses.sm: O le ua fai aufana e le tumau ia; ma le ua toto“e tele vave e le sao ai o ia; o le tietie i le solofanua e le faasaoina ai foi e ia lona ola.

verses.en: And he that is courageous among the mighty shall flee away naked in that day, saith the LORD.
verses.sm: O le toa ua sili lona loto tele, e sola 18 lavalava o ia i lea aso, o loo fetalai mai ai le ALII.
